about_the_game:
Welcome to Kitty Rush! – a 2D puzzle-platformer with claws and cucumbers

Step into the shoes of a veterinary student whose dream internship turns into a cosmic cat-astrophe. What was supposed to be a quiet clinical placement in a run-down vet clinic quickly spirals into chaos after a mysterious alien entity crashes the party... and the clinic.

The building is in ruins, feline patients are scattered and in danger, and only you can save them from scary spiders and cosmic creatures!

🎮 Game Features

  • 2D Puzzle Platformer Adventure: Explore hand-crafted levels full of environmental hazards, puzzles, and alien enemies.

  • Cat Rescue Mechanics: Find and collect lost cats, including rare chonky cats, to improve your ending!

  • Mini-games Inspired by Classics: Play arcade-style cat-themed mini-games, including pong with yarn ball, tic-tac-paw and many others.

  • Unique Locations: Explore the clinic, a dark basement full of traps, and even outer space—each with its own enemies and hazards

  • Combat and Tools: Use a pipe-like "weapon" to clear obstacles and stun enemies.

  • Resource Management: Balance your health (hearts) and lives to survive each level. Use checkpoints and collectible items to stay alive.

  • Cute... but Dangerous: Don’t be fooled by the adorable theme—Kitty Rush has teeth. Puzzle failures, falling boxes, and angry cucumbers await.

🐈 Why You’ll Love It

Kitty Rush is a blend of nostalgic inspiration from Zelda: Oracle of Seasons and Diamond Rush, infused with modern puzzle, platformer design and cute kitties. Whether you're chasing 100% completion or just want to save as many furry friends as possible, Kitty Rush will challenge your reflexes and logic, and maybe tug a little on your heartstrings.

short_description: Kitty Rush is a 2D single-player puzzle platformer where you play as a vet student trapped in an animal clinic invaded by alien forces. Solve puzzles, collect kittens, dodge danger, and fight for your final grade… and their fluffy lives!
